summary: Graphene & Solar Technologies filed an 8-K on September 17, 2026 reporting that its common stock was approved for trading on the OTCQB Venture Market, with trading commencing September 15, 2026, under the ticker GSTX. The uplisting from OTCID Basic followed OTC Markets Group approval and satisfaction of OTCQB financial, reporting, verification and market-eligibility standards. CEO Jason May framed it as a step toward a potential future Nasdaq listing. GSTX is also conducting a private offering of up to $40 million of convertible notes to fund U.S. silicon wafer manufacturing. This is a market-tier upgrade, not a special situation; watch liquidity and convertible placement.
